note:
The bundled post-rewrite hook resolves the rewrite script via
`$REPO_ROOT/skills/why-notes/src/rewrite.py` — that is, it assumes the
consuming repo has the skill installed at exactly that path. This
holds for the why-notes repo itself and for any repo where users
vendor the skill in alongside their notes corpus (the documented
installation pattern). It does NOT work if the skill lives elsewhere
on the system; users in that situation must either symlink the skill
into the repo, configure `core.hooksPath` to a different hook script,
or invoke `rewrite.py --stdin` from a custom hook.

The test suite cannot exercise the bundled hook verbatim because the
temp git repos created in `PostRewriteHookTests.setUp` don't carry the
skill files. Tests use a separate `tests`-only hook that exec's the
real `rewrite.py` from the source tree directly. A separate test
(`BundledHookTests`) covers the bundled script's executability and
shape so the install-time assumption stays documented.
